title: Test case 10 — Trafficking methylamphetamine to students near a school (the 500-metre conditional maximum)
shows: A maximum that depends on a condition: trafficking within 500 metres of a school (admitted) raises the maximum from 15 to 20 years, and the app applies the higher maximum only because the form also confirms the statutory condition — the Manual's table, its text and its footnote describe the condition differently (shown as a caution with its flag). No category or minimum, so the full range of dispositions is open.
